picks.editorial_note: A $38M ARPA-H award — the largest research grant in UVM's history — to build AI 'digital twins' of critically ill patients could transform real-time ICU decision-making nationally.
picks.title: Your AI Twin Could Save Your Life: UVM Awarded up to $38M…

picks.editorial_note: Harvard's $150M strategic research initiative is one of its largest-ever direct science investments, signaling institutional commitment to AI-adjacent fields like quantum computing and neuroscience amid tightening federal funding.
picks.title: Harvard launches $150 million research initiative— Harvard Gazette

picks.editorial_note: Georgia Tech and Amazon's new joint Science Hub formalizes a decade-long partnership into sustained funding for AI research, a model for how industry giants are embedding themselves in academic R&D.
picks.title: Georgia Tech and Amazon Launch Joint Science Hub

picks.editorial_note: MIT's AI-optimized lipid nanoparticle formulation lets RNA vaccines stay stable at room temperature for up to a year, a breakthrough with major implications for vaccine distribution in low-resource settings.
picks.title: New formulation helps RNA vaccines withstand high temperatures

picks.editorial_note: UW-Madison's AI-driven 'brain roadmap' tools link cellular and genetic changes to Alzheimer's progression on an individual basis, advancing personalized medicine approaches to a disease with no cure.
picks.title: ‘We built a brain roadmap for each person’: New AI-driven tools help decode Alzheimer’s disease at the cellular level

picks.editorial_note: Brown engineers' retina-inspired imaging system that can see through fog demonstrates a genuinely novel bio-inspired AI approach with clear applications in autonomous vehicles and defense sensing.
picks.title: Brown University engineers build brain-inspired imaging system that can ‘see’ through fog

picks.editorial_note: An international team's analysis of how AI data centers strain power grids — pointing to real-world cases like xAI's Memphis gas turbines — adds hard evidence to the policy debate over AI's energy footprint and fossil-fuel reliance.
picks.title: AI Data Centers: A Challenge for the Power Grid

picks.editorial_note: A $4.25M DARPA grant to a WashU-led team fuses AI with physics-based simulation to improve fuel injector design, illustrating how defense research dollars are increasingly flowing toward AI-physics hybrids.
picks.title: WashU-led team wins $4M DARPA grant to improve fuel injector design

picks.editorial_note: Cambridge's open-source Tessera model maps smallholder crops in Senegal more accurately than existing tools while using far less compute, a concrete example of AI delivering real-world value in the Global South.
picks.title: AI tool for mapping smallholder crops proves itself in Senegal

picks.editorial_note: Anthropic's Claude text watermarking, implemented to comply with the EU AI Act, is a concrete test case of how AI companies are operationalizing emerging AI regulation.
picks.title: Will Claude's new AI "watermark" keep us all honest?
